title: İlk aranan

characters.WOMAN: a woman of about thirty-two with a long dark braid, wearing a mustard yellow sweater
characters.YOUNG: a young man of about twenty-two with messy light brown hair, wearing a red hoodie
characters.GIRL: a girl of about ten with a long dark braid, wearing a mustard yellow nightdress
characters.LITTLE: a little boy of about four with messy light brown hair, wearing red pajamas

scenes.text:
Küçük kardeşin başı sıkışınca
hâlâ neden ilk seni arıyor?
scenes.prompt: At night, {WOMAN} sits on a sofa under a warm lamp, a phone lighting up on the coffee table in front of her, she looks at it with a tired sigh, rain on the window.

scenes.text:
Sınavı kötü geçer, kalbi kırılır,
arabası yolda kalır.
scenes.prompt: On a rainy roadside at dusk, {YOUNG} stands next to a small broken-down car with its hood open, looking helpless, autumn leaves on the wet road.

scenes.text:
Sen söylenirsin
ama yine de ceketini alıp çıkarsın.
scenes.prompt: On a rainy evening, {WOMAN} hurries down the front steps of an apartment building under an open umbrella, glowing street lamps.

scenes.text:
Çünkü çocukken karanlıktan korkunca
hep senin yatağına gelirdi.
scenes.prompt: At night in a child's room lit by a small star-shaped lamp, {LITTLE} stands beside the bed while {GIRL} lifts the edge of her quilt to let him in, both smiling.

scenes.text:
Sen onun hâlâ en güvenli yerisin.
Bunu kardeşine gönder.
scenes.prompt: On a rainy evening, {WOMAN} on the left and {YOUNG} on the right sit side by side on the curb under one umbrella next to the broken car, his head on her shoulder, both smiling.

caption:
İlk kimi arıyor?

Söylenmen geçer, onun sana güveni geçmez. 🤍

Bunu kardeşine gönder.
